title: B12 accepted higher-cost REFERENCE workload candidate search

search_contract.purpose: Determine whether source-bound B12 hydraulic parameters yield at least one accepted REFERENCE case with aggregate interval cost above the admitted baseline without changing production source or numerical policy.
search_contract.acceptance_requirement: completed + committed + complete authoritative mass + hard mass residual <= 1e-12
search_contract.higher_cost_requirement: at least one aggregate interval cost counter strictly above the admitted baseline vector

mapping_hypothesis_to_verify.note: The candidate gate must source-lock or independently justify this mapping before interpreting results.

claim_limit: This subunit is a source-bound diagnostic search for an accepted difficult REFERENCE candidate. A positive candidate is not scientifically admitted until an independent F-VQ gate qualifies the exact workload and provenance. A negative result does not justify relaxing mass conservation, temporal acceptance, physics or numerical policy.
